paper.title_en: Kiselev black hole from semiclassical gravity with conformal anomaly
paper.abstract_en: Investigating black hole physics in semi-classical gravitational theory is an interesting and important direction. When the backreaction of the conformal anomaly-induced effective stress-energy tensor is taken into account, the black hole spacetime can be largely altered which changes many properties of the black hole. In this work, rather than restricting our attention to the type-A anomaly, we incorporate the type-B anomaly and investigate how it modifies the spacetime structure obtained when only the type-A anomaly is considered. We find that for a specific relation between the central charges and the cosmological constant, the semiclassical Einstein equations can be solved analytically, yielding a metric that takes the exact form of the Kiselev black hole. After deriving the solution, we further discuss the properties of this new black hole solutions. Our work serves as an essential stepping stone for studying black hole geometries under the full conformal anomaly.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究含共形反常反作用的半经典爱因斯坦方程，并解析得到与Kiselev黑洞形式一致的度规，属于半经典引力与基础引力理论方向；理论构造有一定深度，方法上给出解析求解，摘要清晰，但新近预印本暂无引用，作为社区信号为中性。
decision.title_zh: 来自含共形反常半经典引力的Kiselev黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 在半经典引力理论中研究黑洞物理是一个有趣且重要的方向。当考虑共形反常诱导的有效应力能量张量的反作用时，黑洞时空可能被大幅改变，从而改变黑洞的许多性质。在本工作中，我们不把注意力局限于A型反常，而是纳入B型反常，并研究它如何改变仅考虑A型反常时所获得的时空结构。我们发现，对于中心荷与宇宙学常数之间的一个特定关系，半经典爱因斯坦方程可以解析求解，得到的度规恰好取Kiselev黑洞的确切形式。在导出该解之后，我们进一步讨论这一新黑洞解的性质。我们的工作是在完整共形反常下研究黑洞几何的必要垫脚石。
